title: Circuit Storm
description: Full 3-round circuit mixing squats, incline push-ups, mountain climbers and burpees for total-body work

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width apart, lower thighs parallel to the floor

exercises.name: Incline push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands on an elevated surface, easier variation

exercises.name: Mountain climbers
exercises.instructions: In a plank, drive knees to chest alternating quickly

exercises.name: Forward lunges
exercises.instructions: Big step forward, back knee grazes the floor

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.instructions: On one forearm, body aligned, hips high

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.instructions: Drop down, hands on the floor, jump feet back, push-up, jump up

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate the body

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
